usedFor: Mollie holds the payments, and Google Docs receives a line through “Add or Replace Text In Tab” after “New Payment”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in Mollie, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each payment lands as text in a tab, so you keep a running log in one place.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add, or only the latest payment survives.
